verdicts.reason: A is just a shrunken copy of the original. At 300x250 the body copy, badge labels, legal line and SOLSTICE wordmark are too small to read, the can is tiny, and the broken missing-asset box still sits in the bottom-right corner, though the hierarchy and reading order survive. B drops the product can entirely and puts the legal fine print directly under the headline, above the body copy. The body text is nearly as big as the headline, the badges and CTA are crammed into a ragged bottom cluster with the missing-asset box pressed against SMALL BATCH, and the SUNSET SALE tag crowds the headline, so its hierarchy and fidelity are worse.
